currentRealCopyReport.copyInventoryFact: Copy included ignored/untracked Cargo.lock, then reported Contract/snapshot/material manifest match the original read-only observation.

confirmedFromReports: Historical receipt snapshot and current reported source snapshot have exactly the same digest string. This is supported published data, not a cloud readback of the latest retained canonical file.
notAssumed: Latest actual canonical file bytes/hash or nested receipt fields equal the October15 report
HEAD/absolute-root/branch equality between historical and current contexts
Unknown historical JSON fields, exact plan/coverage/execution/retention content, or completeness of native amendment chain
minimumRawFieldsNeeded: Latest old canonical raw bytes plus file hash; envelope contractDigest/repositorySnapshotDigest/repo/WI/producer runtime/captureMode/receiptDigest and full embedded typed receipt/plan/coverage/execution/retention
Current native snapshot digest and Contract; Summary checkpoint/preflight/invalidation and native prepared+committed transition anchors
Current effective policy/profile/material plan and old blocked Outcome/decision receipts
implementationBoundary: Do not impose an unverified blanket old/current HEAD, root or snapshot equality guard. Validate historical receipt snapshot binding separately from current-source freshness. Equal reported digests support the main equivalent fixture; changed-source/unknown-history cases require supported proof/recovery or an explicit bounded diagnostic, never a generic Stale bypass.
